title: stream gapped
description: A board missed events and reloads its state; the shared shape of mankit/v1, sent by designer, so a board handles a gap the same way as every other app's client.

source.description: /designer/<project>: the event comes from e-designer and names the project it serves, so a reader listening to many products and projects knows which stream gapped (ADR-E2, ADR-S08).
